identity_check: Confirmed as Maneva (maneva.ai), the 'Video-to-Action AI' company for manufacturing founded in 2021 by Rae Jeong (CEO, ex-Google DeepMind) and Kelvin Chan (CTO, ex-Magna), with offices in Palo Alto, CA and North York (Toronto), ON. The company's own about, news and funding pages, BetaKit (2026-06-12), Osler's deal pages (company counsel), parsers.vc and inforcapital all describe the same product (VITA and ALIS agents on existing factory cameras) and the same investors (seed co-led by Bling Capital and Freestyle Capital; Series A led by USVP). Not any other business using the Maneva name; identity tied to the maneva.ai domain. Not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; found through a discovery search. Category set to adjacent: its agents watch production lines through cameras to catch defects, cut downtime, flag safety hazards and supervise line productivity, which overlaps Utopian Autonomy's process-stability and maintenance (downtime) functions on the plant floor, but it is a computer-vision product, not conversational agents; no procurement, RFQ / BOM / drawing or WhatsApp features were seen.

company.name: Maneva
company.description: Palo Alto / Toronto start-up whose 'Video-to-Action' AI agents run on existing factory cameras to catch defects, cut downtime, flag safety hazards and supervise line productivity.

layer_detail: Camera-based plant-floor AI: VITA (Video-to-Action agent for quality assurance and downtime reduction) and ALIS (AI Line Supervisor for safety and productivity) run on cameras already installed in the plant (or ones Maneva helps choose), with NVIDIA edge devices; an Orchestration Platform launched July 2026 connects agents across a facility, with 'AI knowledge agent' features planned. Spans quality_vision and plant_ops (downtime, MTBF, line supervision, safety). Industries cited: food and beverage, confectionery, meat processing, pharma, cosmetics, steel, glass, wood / lumber, automotive, electronics, distribution.
product_summary: Computer-vision agents on a plant's existing cameras: VITA watches each product and operator to catch defects and reduce downtime; ALIS acts as an AI line supervisor for safety and productivity; an orchestration platform links agents across the facility. Runs on edge hardware; equipment rental offered in special cases.
